name: M.429 300 50ct (MAXIMUS, 300 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".357 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footer: the coefficient numbers are confirmed by independent testing and by the Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".179 EST". Marked EST: estimated; the page states no accuracy. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 5, MAXIMUS Bullets: Caliber .429, Grains 300, Minimum Required Twist 1-20", Part Number M.429 300 50ct, G1 BC .357 (O89), G7 BC .179 EST, OAL 1.227", BULLET PROJECTION .750"

note: Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .750". The same G1 .357 and G7 .179 are printed for MZL M.430 300.
